Find the mistake in each sentence and choose the correct answer.

  1. I couldn'twasn't able(Clear)can't     swim well when I was younger.

    We use could/couldn't/(not) be able to to talk about our ability or skills in general in the past.

  2. It was a difficult climb, but I can'tmanaged to(Clear)could     reach the top of the mountain.

    We use (not) manage to to talk about a specific task.

  3. I wanted to book a flight but I couldn'tcan't(Clear)am not able    . The website wasn't working.

    The speaker uses past tenses so this sentence is about past ability.
